title: When Neither Side Confirms: Destructive Tool Approval Across MCP Servers and Hosts
title_zh: 当双方都不确认时：MCP服务器与宿主间的破坏性工具审批

paragraphs.en: 研究发现MCP生态中大量破坏性工具缺乏人工审批机制，宿主默认弹窗可大幅降低风险。 LLM agents call tools that delete data or move money through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The specification asks for a human who can deny tool calls but splits the mechanism between the server, which can annotate a tool or ask the user through the host (elicitation), and the host application, which decides whether to prompt. We measure both sides from source code. In a 1,000-repository sample of the official MCP registry, an estimated 90% of destructive tools (95% CI 82-95) have no server-side confirmation, and most servers that elicit proceed, or fall back to a flag the model can set, when the host cannot relay the question. Of 41 popular open-source hosts and agent SDKs, 32 have no approval step by default, including 16 of 25 applications. Pairing sampled destructive tools flagged by a rule-based extractor with these applications, 60.7% of pairs have no enforced human approval by default. Through four agent SDKs, four of five low-cost models executed an injected deletion in 479 of 960 runs. If hosts prompted for every tool not annotated read-only or non-destructive, the unapproved share of these pairs would fall to 5.4%; universal elicitation support would leave 56.7%. Applications should therefore configure approval.
paragraphs.zh: 研究发现，大语言模型智能体通过模型上下文协议（MCP）调用会删除数据或转移资金的工具。 该规范要求有人能够拒绝工具调用，但将这一机制分散在服务器与宿主应用程序之间：服务器可以注解工具或通过宿主向用户提问（elicitation），而由宿主应用程序决定是否弹出提示。 我们从源代码出发对两侧进行了测量。 在官方 MCP 注册表的 1,000 个仓库样本中，估计 90% 的破坏性工具（95% 置信区间 82-95）没有服务器侧确认，而且在宿主无法转发问题时，大多数支持 elicitation 的服务器会选择继续执行，或回退到模型可以自行设置的标志位。 在 41 个流行的开源宿主和智能体 SDK 中，32 个默认没有审批步骤，其中包括 25 个应用程序中的 16 个。 将基于规则的提取器标记的抽样破坏性工具与这些应用程序配对后，60.7% 的配对在默认情况下没有强制的人工审批。 通过四个智能体 SDK，五个低成本模型中的四个在 960 次运行中有 479 次执行了注入的删除操作。 如果宿主对每个未标注为只读或非破坏性的工具都弹出提示，这些配对中未经审批的比例将降至 5.4%；而普遍支持 elicitation 则只能留下 56.7%。 因此，应用程序应当配置审批机制。
